notes.title: WW2 Rebuilder | Patch 1.5.1
notes.content:
This patch fixes some issues on the new Remagen level, and also removes bugs that came out with the DLC launch.

Some of the level-specific changes may appear on the player's side only after a hard restart of that level.

CHANGELOG
[list]
[*] Adjusted collision that was blocking the path in the underground tunnel on RAF Lympne level
[*] Fixed the bug allowing players to destroy the house with the tank on Remagen level before moving the wreck out, which blocked player’s progress
[*] Added missing roof models on Remagen level
[*] Added fixable ceiling in Remagen train station corridor
[*] Blocked of the balconies on Remagen level, that could’ve caused players to stuck
[*] Fixed background NPC spawns on Remagen level
[*] Adjusted wheels placement in one of vehicle props
[*] Various minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: WW2 Rebuilder | Major Patch 1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

[h3][b]We prepared for you new major WW2 Rebuilder update![/b][/h3]

We get your reports on [b]Community forum[/b], via [b]reviews[/b], on [b]discord[/b] and on [b]e-mail (support@madnetic-games.com)[/b]. We try to respond as fast as we can and keep track of all the feedback, so please, be patient. The fastest way to reach us is via discord channel, which you can join here -> [url=https://discord.com/invite/5NB6wKjQBx][click][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/5NB6wKjQBx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png[/img][/url]

Remember to check your files integrity first, it solves a lot of problems beforehand - [url= https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]Verify Integrity of Game Files[/url]

Thank you for all your support! We hope that these new changes will help you enjoy WW2 Rebuilder as you should. 

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]  
[list]
[*] Improved physics of a dragged objects by crane for more controllable behavior
[*] Objects that are attached to crane rope can no longer hit the vehicle
[*] Resized silo on Essen map, improved behavior of the map quest objects
[*] Crane camera changed perspective and added rotation for better driving experience
[*] London map general collisions improved
[*] Clean & Decorate sub-tasks progress added to main mission widget for better clarity of progress
[*] Dunkirk plane and boat have increased friction with the ground so they drift less
[*] Fixed blocker where flipped on back Dunkirk plane couldn't be cut using a cutting torch
[*] Dunkirk plane should no longer clip under landscape
[*] Fixed stuck spot on Hamburg pier 
[*] Fixed drowning bug loop on Hamburg map
[*] Deleted clipping street bollards on Hamburg
[*] Mouse invert not saving properly after game restart
[*] Prevent simultaneous use of F and LMB that lead to objects shrink down
[*] Wheelbarrow inventory saving fix
[*] Increasing garbage cleanup quest by props projection fixed
[*] Bus is now pushed from the London bus hole when it's filled
[*] Lympne jeep trailer re-spawn after map reload fixed 
[*] Permanent outlines on finished interactions if mesh was highlighted and fixed
[*] Exit from Sandbox mode leads to Poland map now
[*] Fixed crash that sometimes occurred on starting a new mission
[*] Deleted outdated journal hints
[*] Fixed unnecessary quest marks on London
[*] Translations bug fixes
[/list]
Keep the bug reports and feedback coming, we are extremely thankful for all of it! It helps us make our game better!

notes.title: WW2 Rebuilder | Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

[h3][b]Our game is released for over two weeks now! [/b][/h3]

We are very satisfied with how you seem to enjoy WW2 Rebuilder and we are thankful for all the feedback and reports. There are some issues that come up from your reviews and messages that we note and work on. 

[b]Here are some of the new things we managed to fix and add this week:[/b]

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]  
[list]
[*] [b] Loading time [/b]
We decreased loading times for our game. 
For those who encounter any stuck during load to main menu for longer then 1-2 min please:
- Hit Alt+Enter to check if problem is not related to Fullscreen resolution mode. We confirmed that on systems below Windows 10. 
- Alternatively please try running game from Rebuilder.exe file directly in administrator mode.
[*] [b] Ladders [/b]
Fix for potential stuck when climb the ladders. 
[*] [b] Dunkirk [/b]
Prevented issues when attachable vehicles would shrink on connect action. If it occurs please reset QWERTY (or appropriate) bindings in Game Settings.
Dunkirk building site area check size reduced to prevent possible block of the progress. 
Fix for some props that would re-spawn after map load
[*] [b] Essen [/b]
Re-designed factory elements that require transport to collect zone.
[*] [b] London [/b]
Increased size of cut decals on airplane that is require to be cut. 
[*] [b] Lympne [/b]
Wing flaps are now available to be craft or build in the workshop table. 
[*] [b] Necropolis [/b]
Fix for providing data to clerk task.
[*] [b] Binding [/b]
Additional re-binding options are now available. 
[*] [b] Translation [/b]
Translation fixes for German and French localization. Thank you every for reporting those to us! We highly appreciate that. Our community is amazing \o/
[/list]
Additionally if you still encounter load crashes or hang please try following:
[list]
[*] Add game to exception folder in Windows Defender Firewall
[*] Temporarily disable antivirus software other that Windows Defender
[*] Restart your computer
[*]  [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/6AD7-820D-8BE5-E51F]Clear download Cache in Steam App[/url]
[*] [url= https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]Verify Integrity of Game Files[/url]
[*] Run game. Possibly reinstalling might give results as we received a lot of reports that files being moved into quarantine by additional non built-in windows application during installation and game couldn't be launched. We also strongly suggest to have game installed on SSD drive.
[/list]
[b]Once again thanks so much feedback and reporting all the issues![/b]

[b]Please, if you have any bugs or suggestions send them to us via [u]Discord server[/u], a [u]forum on Community[/u] or to our email  [u](support@madnetic-games.com)[/u][/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/5NB6wKjQBx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png[/img][/url]

Keep the bug reports and feedback coming and stay awesome!

notes.title: WW2 Rebuilder | Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

[b]We prepared a next update to WW2 Rebuilder that includes various fixes.[/b]

But first we want to point out a few troubleshooters for situations when game get closed right after start or during a first loading screen. In such case we suggest the following:

[olist]
[*] Add game to exception folder in Windows Defender Firewall
[*] Temporarily disable antivirus software other that Windows Defender
[*] Restart your computer
[*]  [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/6AD7-820D-8BE5-E51F]Clear download Cache in Steam App[/url]
[*] [url= https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]Verify Integrity of Game Files[/url]
[*] Run game
[/olist]
We also strongly suggest to have game installed on SSD drive.

[b]Additionally we have 2 emergency options when physics make you stuck somwhere:[/b]
[list]
[*] 'Unstuck' button under pause menu that will get you back to last saved position
[*] 'Unstuck to starting point' - when first doesn't help just Save&Quit map, Load the level again and do NOT move, just press 'ESC' and hit 'Unstuck' to be moved back to starting point of character.
[/list]

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]  
[list]
[*] [b] FRenderThreadScope crash [/b]
Possible fix to crash happening during Alt-Tab of the game.
[*] [b] Autosaves improvements[/b]
Fixed several issues with autosaves that could lead to game crash.
[*] [b] Dunkirk[/b]
Fixed situation when dragged car to parking lot for dismantle after re-load would be still visiable
Prevent possibility of dragged objects being throw away into the ocean.
[*] [b]Controller[/b] 
Fix preventing mouse cursor jumping in front while playing with controller
[/list]
[b]Once again thanks so much feedback and reporting all the issues![/b]

[b]Join our discord: it's the fastest way to keep in touch with us:[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/5NB6wKjQBx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png[/img][/url]

Keep the bug reports and feedback coming and stay awesome!

notes.title: WW2 Rebuilder | Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

First 10 days of WW2 Rebuilder being out were quite amazing! [b]We have over 300 reviews and 91% of them are positive![/b] We are really happy with the reception of our game but we're aware of the flaws it has and we've been preparing fixes for this update.

[b]We prepared a next to WW2 Rebuilder.[/b]

[h2]Patch notes below:[/h2]  [h3]But first we have huge request to everyone, after you update the game please perform [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB]Verify Integrity of Game Files[/url]. We receive reports it solves a lot of random issues. Thank you!
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added 'Vehicle Respawn' button to pause menu. [/b]
It will move all vehicles to their starting point and detach connected item in case of any issues. 
[*] [b]Game Loading TIme[/b] (we are still working on that)
We provide potential improvement of loading time. We also verified cases where external antivirus applications could prevent game from loading or extend load time tremendously. Please verify on your end by temporarily removing it to see if helps. We also suggest to keep the game on SSD drive whenever it's possible.
[*] [b]Essen[/b] 
Reworked collision and physics in factory to avoid possible issues while dragging out task objects
[*] [b]Dunkirk[/b] 
Solved issue where objects attached to jeep loose interaction after Save/Load of the level.
Reduced required wrecked count from 12 to 8 for in "Toy away the wrecks" task
[*] [b]London[/b]
Prevent possibility of moving rubble away from a bus hole that would block progress
Fixed issues with a filled bus hole where parts of airplane could disappear near it's location
Airplane wreckage fixes for easier behavior of airplane during removing it from construction site
[*] [b]Lympne[/b]
Possible fix for painting parking lanes where it doesn't allow to finish task
Added additional notifications for repair tables
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]
Fixed issues with not unlocking 5 stars achievements 

[*] Fixed situation when some of the intractable objects would re-spawn after reload
[*] Increased FOV range in settings for wider monitors support
[*] Belfast crane steering description revised
[*] Repaired issues with the connector building on Dunkirk that could reappear visually after Load
[*] Prevent mission items to available for sell/dismantle in the Workshop
[*] Fixed various collectable materials that couldn't be collected with a Hand Tool
[*] Fixed not properly displaying message about received Ability Points
[*] Korean translation fixes to the in-game shortcuts
[*] Reduced audio volume for map intro cut-scenes
[*] Minor fixes and improvements
[/list]
NOTE: please keep in mind that Steam App will require additional temporal disc space equal game size to perform the patch which is cleared afterwards. We will be solving that inconvenience with patching soon. 

[b]We thank you for giving us so much feedback and reporting all the issues. We highly appreciate it![/b]. 
[b]Join our discord: it's the fastest way to keep in touch with us![/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/5NB6wKjQBx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png[/img][/url]

*Keep the bug reports and feedback coming and stay awesome!*

notes.title: Devlog #15 Hamburg
notes.content:
[h1]Builders![/h1]

As you know already, playtests for our prologue and coming in big. And you all really like our stories about certain locations and maps. 

Let us continue our adventure and take this opportunity and introduce you further to the city of Hamburg.

In short after battle for Ruhr, the alliance took as it's next target the city of Hamburg. Operation Gomora was supposed to paralyze the biggest German docks and submarine factory complex. The goal was reached, although with difficulties in the future with setting the next goals caused by the smoke that was covering the building. All the docks and factories were destroyed according to the plan and pushed out of commission for at least a month.
Unfortunately, more than 3/4 of the city was destroyed with 40 thousand lives were taken by the ravages of war and explosions

What's our story?

Let us hear what our Hero has to say:
"I remember the paralyzing fear I felt reading in the newspapers about the bombings of Hamburg in 1943. My Andreas' unit was stationed in the city at the time. I was worried sick for weeks, and finally a letter from the Wehrmacht arrived: Andreas was severely burned but alive!
They say all the Allies wanted at the time was to stop the Nazi U-boat production. They succeeded, but at the same time Hamburg with its inhabitants burned almost completely. When the incendiary bombs penetrated through to the cellars full of coal, all hell broke loose
Now I arrive in Hamburg, witnessing the aftermath of the monstrous firestorms my husband had once encountered."

What's more?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/b2b86fc2149f02959871fdc03ee75094643dfd58.png[/img]
One of the players' task is to rebuild the bell tower of St. Nicolas Church that hasn't been rebuilt till this day. Don't forget to clean the rubble- it will be used in further rebuilding of the coast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/1a709364998299ec70cd30d06cdfdab7e34706bf.png[/img]
We've heard that you would be interested in some new buildings and spaces to build - here you go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/3d4cf6cdb55498c8ed66c2ab6e4076fa927e606e.png[/img]
Rebuilding is a hard job- to make it easier, we're dropping you a boat that can be helpful during rebuilding of some wooden bridges

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/db88c7c1d950555f897129ea0b036acf0fcdd89a.png[/img]
Another task for you in this area will be rebuilding old trement house with a rift that you can paint with the color of your choosing.

Remember- playtests for the prologue are getting near. Hope our today's devlog got you more excited for them.

Till next time!

notes.title: Devlog #13 Belfast Shipyard
notes.content:
Not losing our pace and this week we are bringing you the next location!

Introducing - [b]Belfast Shipyard[/b]

Yes, the same one that Titanic was created in! Originally Belfast was quite an important industry center - military included. Despite the high status, during WW2 the city of Belfast had really poor defense. Numbers of bunkers and anti-aircraft missiles were too low, but it was mostly due the fact that people thought the shipyard is too far from the continent to be attacked by the Nazis.

What's our story?

Our Builder is sent to Belfast to take part in renovations of the shipyard inspired by Harland and Wolff’s. Main reason is that during the war, most of the alliance weaponry and military ships, RF aircraft carriers. Most of the ships were damaged during the Blitz, but most of the infrastructure had equally big imprint of the bombing.

What more?

notes.title: Devlog #12 RAF Lympne
notes.content:
[h1]Builders![/h1]

Your positive feedback about what we're sharing with you gave us a path for future posts. So by popular demand, continuing the series:

Introducing-  [b]RAF Lympne[/b]

According to history pages, before WW2, Royal Air Force station was base for Cinque Ports Flying Club. Although RAF Lympne was only a temporary base for technical issues, receiving transport and preparing for the missions and not a pit stop, it was at risk of bombarding during the war. There was even a possibility of Hans Bauer, who was Hitler's personal pilot, kidnapping the Führer and hand him over as a prisoner, but the mission hadn't eventuated.

During the Battle of Britain, the whole airport was bombarded and was beyond usage. All the Cinque Ports Flying Club planes that hadn't been evacuated, were destroyed beyond repair. For most of the time, the airport was only used as an emergency base.
After the War, RAF Lympne went into civilian use, mostly as a UK - France route.

What's our story?

Our English Rebuilder is sent to RAF Lympne, Kent, on the south. There, the objective is to prepare the whole airport to become an air ferry port between UK and France. The goal is for daily transport of the supplies.

What's more?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/4f24fd4eee372a6ca51b05748a28ea89891c9ae0.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #8 Necropolis
notes.content:
[h1]Builders![/h1]

As you may noticed, works got more intense and because of that, we can share with you of the goods we are preparing for the future.

This week will be little bit grime, but it's important part of the history, so here it goes

Introducing:[b] NECROPOLIS[/b]

According to history books, Necropolis station was created for mourners and the dead to transport them outside of the city to Brookwood Cemetery. The reason was owergrowth of the deceased century ago and cities begun to be ravaged with plauges, because of that. During The Blitz the place was bombed and the chapel and the waiting room were ruined, the railroad was disconnected and the trains where either burned down or destroyed.

Our storyline begins with our Hero, who as one of many volunteers wanted to join the reconstruction of the fallen London, but because of his experience after rebuilding Gimpert, he's being assigned to work on rebuilding Necropolis.

Okay, so what you can expect in this map?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/6b375279066339764722d80a4c8300d76beeb105.png[/img]
We tried to show the entrance to Necropolis as close as it is possible to the original

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/483d9858c294e4ea5de4e4f90297746130f05b88.png[/img]
One of your tasks will be fixing one of the engine that will be lifted. Extra task will be replacing old wheels with new ones that will be hidden all over the map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/95ed16fa6c45df907755d3f9f36e01b1eccf5c07.png[/img]
Remember that the chapel was one of the things that was destroyed by the bombs? Now you will be able to rebuild it according the the original and as a great way as a comparison for before and after.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/8585a5f2e43d5dfae10218cdf71f76c7565b6b96.png[/img]
Another mission will be helping one of the clerks in finding lost documents and a coffin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/3907f2abc5331b24efc65eead4bc73dd92ae5eb9.png[/img]
Remember the 'Keep calm..' phase that flooded the internet few years ago? Originally the 'Keep Calm and Carry On' poster was created to help people of London get through The Blitz and normalise thow whole situation.

Okay that's it for now!

notes.title: Devlog #5 Crane & wrecking ball
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/b641582c3a6a02a9394b320c0c49967494a61c82.png[/img]

[h1]BUILDERS![/h1]

This week we want to introduce you to our second helpful giant with his friends- crane and wrecking ball!

Acording to the books, the model we are presenting to you is called a crawler. A crawler crane has its boom mounted on an undercarriage fitted with a set of crawler tracks that provide both stability and mobility. Crawler cranes range in lifting capacity from about 40 to 4,000 long tons (44.8 to 4,480.0 short tons; 40.6 to 4,064.2 t).[
Wide tracks spread the weight out over a great area and are far better than wheels at traversing soft ground without sinking in. A crawler crane is also capable of traveling with a load. Its main disadvantage is its weight, making it difficult and expensive to transport. 

Our crawler is designed to lift heavy objects and place them where you want to. Also while in the wehicle, you can lift and lower the hook.

Check out how awesome the mode looks

notes.title: Playtest Extended & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

We're excited to bring you some cool news that you might love!

Due to really high interest in our [b]playtests[/b], we have decided to give you more time in our world of rebuilding and leave the gates open till [b]JANUARY 23rd![/b]
3 extra days of testing- can you imagine?

So don't miss your opportunity to join the fun!

[b]Here are a patch note fixes that comes along:[/b]
[list]
[*] Don't need to change tool for put/take interaction with containers
[*] Support for AZERTY keyboards
[*] Motion Blur disabled by default
[*] V-Sync ON by default
[*] Locked mouse cursor on opened UI
[*] Opening UI now dis activate current tool (e.g infinitive blow torch)
[*] Sense outline fixed in certain situations
[*] TPP perspective has been removed
[*] Scrolling through tool now is locked while having UI opened
[*] Console is hidden
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/ZVfJSNvhce][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/0816c1252872ba008f0444ff21b3b75c13ff9106.png[/img][/url]
